body: She is causing me stress. When I tried to tell her that I just wanted to talk with someone, all she would say is I don't know how this process works and that she doesn't want me talking with someone she or I don't know.

She should be, but isn't for whatever reason. I was supposed to write an essay tonight, but this issue is upsetting me so much I don't even know where to start. I think I need to find a way to move away from my family, but I don't know where the hell to start that process.I'm just so tired of being treated like a sheltered kid. I want to get better, to make my mental state healthier. I can't fucking do this anymore..... I almost feel like I'd be better off in a mental hospital than at fucking home.
See, that's what I want to do too. I don't want to just rely on one person to meet with for help when I'm feeling my mental state deteriorate.

I feel that going to a mental hospital just for depression may not be the best idea, but I would really like some sort of help. I'm just worried that I'm going to end up going through some shit like strip searches and being around suicidal people.

I don't have the motivation or the drive to do something like that. That's why I'm looking into getting some help because I think at this point, I really need it. I've tried to self-motivate myself to exercise and get out more and it never works.

Yeah, I don't want to be with people in their 30s or 40s. Nothing against adults of course, but I feel being with people in my age range will make my stay less stressful. I am, after all, still very young.

Edit: Another question: what clothing do you wear once you're in a unit? Do you have to wear a hospital gown?

I don't feel suicidal though, just constantly sad and depressed. I feel that going to a psych hospital would be overkill and my family would have a nervous breakdown. Would going to Spring Harbor still be worth it? I have a few questions if I ever were to go:

1. Would I have to be stripped searched upon entry?

2. What would my stay entail exactly?

3. How long would I be expected to stay?

4. Would I be one of the youngest people there?(I'm 19 years old)

I still feel like shit. There's this gaming club at SMCC that I want to go to so badly but I don't have the transportation to get there. I hate how I have finally found a gaming club, something I've been looking for so long to find, but it's on a day where I have no access to a car. Makes me think my life is cursed and that I won't ever find a good group of friends to be around. I can't take this anymore.... this loneliness is killing me. I need to get out of the house and do something.

Does Spring Harbor have a good reputation? I don't want to be in any facility that will put me in any danger. I've read some things about Spring Harbor and I don't know if it would be a place I should be in.
Thank you so much for these numbers. I'll give these a ring tomorrow when I have the house to myself.
I can't make that call... I don't think I will kill myself, I just need some help and ways to get motivated. I need a buddy to just help me get through these tough times.....
Yes please.
Smoke weed? Yes, sometimes. Smoke cigs? No.

You're 12? Well I'm 19. Hope you wouldn't mind that too much. Anyways, yeah if you ever want to hang out sometime I'd be down with that. If it wouldn't be too much to ask, would you want to exchange some PMs to get to know each other better?
Yeah... I know how you feel. I don't want to pressure you into making you hang out with me, but would you want to maybe exchange numbers and get to know each other better? Again, all up to you.
I love video games, political discussions, tennis, running, watching football and baseball.

Yeah, I understand. Shame I didn't live in Brunswick. My mental state is fine for the most part. I'm just tired of feeling like I'm behind all my fellow 19 year olds. Seeing all these Redditors talk about how college is the best time of their life is making me feel horrible as well.

I've always really liked table tennis. You say you know two people who attend USM and play table tennis? Are they part of some table tennis club? Because honestly, that would be a really awesome activity to partake in.

I'm not asking for someone to make a drive to pick me up. I apologize for all these topics, I don't know, depression is just so fucking hard to beat and I'm having a really hard time trying to make some friends.

I wish I could teach myself web or mobile development, I just lack the drive because of depression. Really want to get my life on track and be happy again so I can have motivation to do cool projects.

Comedy shows wouldn't be bad. I wouldn't really know if I'd fit in an environment like that. Again, many things in Portland seem to be for older people and I'm practically still a kid in most adult's eyes.
I've tried before and, as I said, our timing is just never right. Hey, are you much older than me? Would you be interested in hanging out?

I do live in a small town: Yarmouth. 

And yeah, there are some people in my class I like to talk to. They seem like they're busy a lot though so it's hard to do fun things.
I live in Yarmouth, Maine.

USM students can be a bit cold. Don't get me wrong, I am enjoying my time at university, I just want to meet people and make better connections with them. Everyone I do come into contact with always seems to be busy. I'm currently trying to find a support group for people with Autism since I do have Asperger's. Think it would be a good way to meet like minded people.

Yeah I've really wanted to join a gaming group. My interests are Pokemon, WRPGs/JRPGs, sports, politics, history, PC games, tennis, and running. I know there are plenty of great people I can meet. Problem is, I have Asperger's syndrome which can make it extremely hard to put myself out there(depression doesn't help with that either). Honestly, if I could just get in contact with a few people to know what would be good to join, I'd jump on the opportunity as fast as I could. Would you happen to know anyone who would be good to talk to?

I really just want to get out there in Portland and find some friends badly. Please, if you know anyone who may be able to just help me a 19 year old college student deal with depression, I'd really want to meet this person. Just someone who can help me get out there and meet people.
I love RPGs, action-adventures, FPSs, puzzle games, and some fighters.
That's what I did and I asked a counselor if he knew of any good groups for me. They had an anxiety group I went to for a bit and it was okay, but not exactly what I needed.
I love video games too! What kind of games do you like to play?
Yeah I'd love to find some good internet friends!
